App allocates new transaction/object/revision IDs and timestamps once per explicit new intent, persists a bounded recoverable prepared record before publication and reuses exact IDs/bytes on retry/reopen/crash recovery. Distinguish a new material from retry; do not deduplicate independent intents implicitly or fabricate success for partial state. Review deterministic serialization, exclusive creation/no-overwrite, flush/recovery, retention and cancellation states first.

Define admissible user-selected source trust/ACL/reparse/hardlink/race policy before implementation; check native handles and final readback. Busy prevents duplicate intent/commands; close/cancel/reopen semantics retain the truthful final outcome and recovery record. UI distinguishes editing/new intent/prepared/published/accepted/replay/conflict/incomplete/UNKNOWN without overriding actual adapter results.

Owned synthetic file/URL/note create→publish→save→Bank discovery→pinned detail/original journeys; explicit search rebuild then correct hit. Reopen/retry with same IDs/exact bytes, actual post-save UNKNOWN→receipt→REPLAY, invalid/oversize/missing/changed file, partial preparation/crash/cancel/busy and safe plain rendering. Independent oracle compares schema, stored bytes/hashes/refs and unchanged baseline. Portable tests supplement actual native NTFS/Tk/native handle/default controller evidence.

Actually launch form and generate native owned-window events for each material kind plus recovery/error/reopen flows; retain owned-client screenshots and observable states, not only presenter mocks. pre_execution_questions.question: Which bounded app-owned prepared-input/journal profile preserves new-intent IDs and exact bytes across partial preparation, publication and restart?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Review a separate private authoring workspace, explicit immutable intent record plus prepared producer input, exclusive creation/flush/readback and declared inspect/resume/cancel states; freeze schema serialization and reuse existing contracts. Select the minimal reliable layout during independent card review, not by changing canonical storage.

pre_execution_questions.question: How should user-selected original trust, note provenance/targets and form integration work without weakening accepted native guards?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Review exact schema profiles and native original-selection handle/ACL/reparse/hardlink policy. Use explicit author/origin fields and optional pinned targets allowed by schema; new adapter/form/subclass owns integration while accepted UI source stays frozen. No URL fetch or shell preview.
